Working towards https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/issues/3484

Separate agent-specific HTTP test entry points from the shared HTTP extensions in preparation for splitting testing infrastructure. Artifacts and coordinates stay unchanged.

```java
AgentHttpClientInstrumentationExtension.create();
AgentHttpServerInstrumentationExtension.create();
```

For 3.0, remove `HttpClientInstrumentationExtension.forAgent()` and `HttpServerInstrumentationExtension.forAgent()` outright. Replace calls with the corresponding `AgentHttp*InstrumentationExtension.create()` factory; `forLibrary()` is unchanged.

Migrate repository callers, including alternate test suites, and preserve the shared HTTP fixture lifecycle.
metadata.title: Introduce agent-specific HTTP testing extensions and migrate callers
